# Yaseen Ahmad (yaseenahmadexe)

> Yaseen Ahmad (online as yaseenahmadexe) is a freelance full-stack developer and final-year BS Software Engineering student at CECOS University of IT and Emerging Sciences in Peshawar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. This site is his portfolio: selected projects with details, screenshots and links to public source code.

## Pages

- [Portfolio home](https://yaseenahmadexe.vercel.app/): Selected projects, project details, screenshots, CV and contact.
- [CV (PDF)](https://yaseenahmadexe.vercel.app/Yaseen-Ahmad-CV.pdf): Curriculum vitae.
- [CECOS QEC Portal — case study](https://yaseenahmadexe.vercel.app/cecos-qec-portal): Case study of the Quality Enhancement Cell website he designed and built for CECOS University, Peshawar (live site: https://qec-page.vercel.app/qec).
- [Software engineering project enquiries](https://yaseenahmadexe.vercel.app/freelance-software-engineer)
- [Web developer in Peshawar](https://yaseenahmadexe.vercel.app/hire-web-developer-peshawar)
- [React, Node.js and full-stack development](https://yaseenahmadexe.vercel.app/mern-stack-developer)
- [Uncensored LLM — free AI chat and open-source server](https://yaseenahmadexe.vercel.app/uncensored-llm): Project page for Uncensored AI, a free uncensored LLM chat (live app: https://uncensored-llm.vercel.app), and the open-source Kaggle GPU server behind it.
